component.name: Auriferous
component.summary: Game inspired by the classic Loderunner

description.p: Auriferous is based on the game mechanics from the classic Loderunner, as such it will feel immediatelt familiar to people who have played it.

The goal is to collect all the gold from the caves and then head for the exit. This sounds simple, but try it. The challenge: Because some bad blue Monks want prevent you from that, they bite of your head if the catch you, good luck.
The further you get the harder the caves become, often they are like mazes with dangers and traps, to pass them you need a lot of skill.
